steps.text:
I've built the game-night podium scoreboard. It passes validation with no errors or warnings, I looked at every coverage frame, and the latest version is recorded in `/mnt/session/outputs/record.json` with `record.zip` beside it. Nothing was saved to your NoaCG library.

**How it looks:** four rounded podiums along the bottom of the screen, in pink, blue, green and purple with light diagonal stripes. Each has the player's name on top and the score in big numbers on a white tile, under a yellow "SCORES" tab. On Take the podiums bounce up one after another, and on Out they drop away.

**Names:** I bundled a font (Poppins Bold) that covers accented letters, and names show as typed rather than in capitals. I tested Zoë, José Ángel and Renée and the accents aren't clipped. A long name like "Bartholomew Okonkwo-Fitzgerald" goes onto two lines and shrinks a little to stay inside its podium.

**These are your buttons, please check they match how you'll run the night:**

| Section | Buttons | What they do |
|---|---|---|
| Score | +1 for each player | adds 1 point |
| Score | −1 for each player | takes 1 point away |
| Spotlight | Spot for each player | that podium jumps up inside a pulsing...
